Container.Name: BTCPayServer
Container.Overview: BTCPay Server is a free and open-source Bitcoin payment processor for self-hosted stores, invoices, checkout, wallets, point-of-sale flows, plugins, and webhooks without third-party payment processor fees.
Container.Requires: This template runs the BTCPay Server application container only. The officially supported deployment is a Docker Compose stack with Postgres, NBXplorer, and a Bitcoin full node, plus optional reverse proxy and Lightning services. Configure those services separately and point the Postgres, Explorer, and Bitcoin variables below at them before using BTCPay with real funds. If using container names such as postgres or nbxplorer, place all containers on the same custom Docker network.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: BTCPay Server web interface and internal API port. Container port: 49392.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent BTCPay Server data directory. Back this directory up before processing real payments.

Config.Name: Bind Address
Config.Description: Address and port BTCPay binds to inside the container.

Config.Name: Network
Config.Description: Bitcoin network. Use mainnet, testnet, signet, or regtest.

Config.Name: Chains
Config.Description: Comma-separated crypto chains enabled in BTCPay. This template defaults to Bitcoin only.

Config.Name: Public Host
Config.Description: Optional public hostname, for example btcpay.example.com. Use a reverse proxy for HTTPS when exposing BTCPay outside your LAN.

Config.Name: Root Path
Config.Description: BTCPay root path when served from a subpath. Use / for normal deployments.

Config.Name: Postgres Connection
Config.Description: Required Postgres connection string for the BTCPay Server database.

Config.Name: Explorer Postgres Connection
Config.Description: Required Postgres connection string for NBXplorer data, used by BTCPay to read explorer state.

Config.Name: BTC Explorer URL
Config.Description: Required NBXplorer URL for Bitcoin, for example http://nbxplorer:32838/ on a custom Docker network or http://UNRAID-IP:32838/.

Config.Name: Docker Deployment Mode
Config.Description: Marks this BTCPay instance as Docker-deployed. Use true or false.

Config.Name: No Default Chain
Config.Description: Prevents BTCPay from assuming a chain without explicit chain variables. Use true or false.

Config.Name: Update URL
Config.Description: Release URL used by BTCPay to check for new versions.

Config.Name: Debug Log
Config.Description: Debug log filename under the BTCPay data directory.

Config.Name: Lightning Connection
Config.Description: Optional Bitcoin Lightning connection string. For example, type=clightning;server=unix://etc/clightning_bitcoin/lightning-rpc, or leave blank to configure later in BTCPay.
